Abadon Shout book

Created Book to learn Abadon Shout, uses dragon souls.
Wrote text for Goo Book.
Added missed Selective Goo Ball to unlock conditions.

More BC changes

Changed craft unlock method to gobal variable instead of quest stages, now works more logical (i.e. available right after gettign dressed into it and not after the quest completes).
Added hood and mittens into approriate functions and conditions.

Updated BC set

Reduced cut resistance of all devices, new devices added to the set.
Now collar and boxbinder received new custom modifiers, especially collar, to make those much more oppressive.
Modifications to recipes and sharing quest are in planning phase.

2.0.1

- Massive number of text edits, thanks to the helper asked to be left anonymous
- changed version to 2.0.1
- Added failsafe hub door unlock in case player gets mittens to drop and lose the key.

Updated

Updated custom devices for the latest modifiers changes.

2 changes

1. Added abadon poison injection into LLs, mod like NPC use potions recommended for NPC to be able to use those.
2. Changed editorID of the hub cell to prevent saves to be marked as for new char, thanks to belegost for report.

Updates for DD NG 0.3.9

- Removed Dasha items from fomod, switched to DD NG ones instead
- Switched draugr Abadon Shout distribution to SPID, SPID now required, better compatibility for Forgotten Dungeons for example
- Moved Unconspicuous House to the adjacent cell, removed conflict with Tundra Homestead, redone navmesh, now it works as it should in AE.
- created Abadon poisons to be distributed to NPC, LL injection is not done yet.

Moved the hub

Moved the Inconspicous House away from Tundra Homestead and cleaned up all edits in that cell.
Redone navmesh around the hub from scratch, hopefully for good this time.

Small improvements

1. Refactored Arcadia's actions to use quest script, like all other actions. Proved to eliminate weird hang ups for some people.
2. Also as experiment added special support for P+ StartScene function with fallback to standard SL call if no P+ present.  Potentially should drastically reduce scene start-up times, needs testing.
3. Changed Abadon Execution script to call SwapDevices function for possibly cleaner code. Needs testing to ensure all works as it should.

Fixes for Shout and Execution potion

1. Added option to disable Abadon Shout reversal in MCM.
2. Added check for completion of the Abadon Curse quest in the Abadon Execution potion.
3. Improved Abadon plug addition  in the Abadon Execution potion.

Reduced priority of Dragon Nuts research

- Reduced priority of Dragon Nuts research among the ingredients
- Added hint about it
Both fixes are by iHateMyKite, thank you!
